sections.title: Medieval Art Seminar: Metal/Work: Dialectics of Matter and Form
sections.description: Alternating specific topic from year to year, this advanced graduate seminar surveys methodological issues concerning the art of the European Middle Ages, broadly conceived. Seminars take advantage of the rich resources of the Philadelphia area. This course is open to graduate students only.
